content.value_statement: Quality leaders need clear oversight across ISO 13485, FDA QSR, and EU MDR duties. This skill structures QMR governance, compliance monitoring, management reviews, and quality strategy.
actual_capabilities: Outline QMR accountability across QMS oversight, compliance, management reporting, and continuous improvement.
Plan regulatory compliance monitoring across EU MDR, FDA QSR, ISO 13485, and national requirements.
Structure management review agendas, dashboards, reports, and escalation topics.
Define quality KPIs for system effectiveness, customer quality, product quality, compliance, and culture.
Guide quality strategy, resource planning, audit oversight, and cross-functional quality integration.
limitations: Does not replace a qualified regulatory affairs or legal review.
Does not verify live regulatory changes or jurisdiction-specific interpretations.
Includes placeholder resources and scripts that are not full working tools.
Requires organization-specific procedures, product risks, and evidence before implementation.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Management Reviews
use_cases.description: Build a structured agenda and reporting package for quarterly quality reviews and board updates.

use_cases.title: Assess Compliance Oversight
use_cases.description: Map current monitoring practices against ISO 13485, EU MDR, FDA QSR, and market obligations.

use_cases.title: Design Quality Strategy
use_cases.description: Translate business goals into quality objectives, KPIs, resource plans, and improvement priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Create a QMR Responsibility Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Act as a QMR advisor. Build a responsibility map for our quality system covering oversight, compliance, management reporting, and improvement. Ask for missing context first.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Management Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a quarterly management review plan for a medical device company. Include agenda topics, required evidence, decision points, owners, and follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate Compliance Gaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our current QMS oversight approach against ISO 13485, EU MDR, and FDA QSR expectations. Identify gaps, risk level, and remediation priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Quality Strategy Roadmap
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 12-month QMR quality strategy for a scaling HealthTech company. Connect compliance risks, KPIs, budget needs, audit readiness, and executive reporting.

output_examples.input: Request: Prepare quarterly QMR management review topics for EU and US markets.
output: Executive quality summary with compliance status, significant risks, and required decisions.
Review sections for QMS performance, complaints, audits, CAPA, suppliers, submissions, and inspection readiness.
Follow-up action table with accountable owners, due dates, evidence needs, and escalation triggers.

output_examples.input: Request: Define KPIs for quality system oversight.
output: QMS effectiveness indicators covering process performance, audit results, nonconformity trends, and CAPA timeliness.
Customer and product quality indicators covering complaints, returns, conformity, defect rates, and quality cost trends.
Compliance and culture indicators covering submission success, inspection outcomes, training completion, and quality engagement.

output_examples.input: Request: Build a 12-month QMR strategy for a growing MedTech company.
output_examples.output: The output is a phased roadmap with compliance priorities, governance milestones, KPI improvements, audit readiness work, resource needs, and executive reporting cadence.

best_practices: Provide current certifications, markets, product classes, and QMS scope before asking for compliance guidance.
Ask for evidence lists and owners so outputs can become auditable action plans.
Have qualified regulatory or quality leaders approve final policies, reports, and submissions.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the skill as legal advice or a substitute for regulatory counsel.
Do not generate final inspection responses without confirming evidence and executive approval.
Do not use generic KPIs without mapping them to product risk and QMS objectives.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure QMR responsibilities, compliance oversight, management reviews, quality KPIs, and quality strategy.

faq.question: Can it replace a QMR?
faq.answer: No. It supports QMR planning and documentation, but accountable quality leaders must review and approve outputs.

faq.question: Which standards does it reference?
faq.answer: It references ISO 13485, EU MDR 2017/745, FDA QSR 21 CFR 820, and national regulatory requirements.

faq.question: Can it prepare management reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure review agendas, evidence needs, dashboards, decision points, and follow-up actions.

faq.question: Does it check live regulatory updates?
faq.answer: No. Users should verify current requirements with official regulators, notified bodies, or qualified counsel.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide product type, jurisdictions, certification status, QMS scope, audit findings, complaint trends, KPIs, and known compliance risks.
